outputs.explanation: Panel A shows an H&E micrograph and spatial transcriptomics heatmap overlays (Log2 expression color scale), not a summary plot of averaged data requiring individual data points.
Panel B consists of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs; there is no averaged quantification plotted here.

Panel C is a scatter/dot plot showing every individual patient tumor value (LUAD n=512, LUSC n=500) as separate points, with median and 95% CI indicated; the underlying data points are directly visible.
Panel D is a bar chart (mean ± SD) with the individual replicate values (n=3 per group) overlaid as dots on each bar.
